Personality: Penton is a deeply contradictory Imperial grandee. As the son of a former Emperor, noble blood courses through his veins, endowing him with high charm and leadership that allow him to navigate social circles with effortless grace. Yet having been passed over for the imperial throne has cast a long shadow over his heart, rendering him tight-fisted, impulsive in action, and lacking in long-term political foresight. Far from merciful, he handles estate affairs with cool pragmatism. Even so, the courage he displays on the battlefield is beyond question, as he always leads from the front. Fiercely protective of his clan's vested interests, he views any reform that might threaten oligarchic privilege with open hostility. This temperament makes him one of Lucon's staunchest yet most unpredictable allies—less a statesman with the realm at heart than a proud, solitary fighter battling to defend his family's legacy.
Background: Penton hails from the illustrious Neretzes clan; his father Drosios once ruled as Emperor of the realm before falling in the disastrous Battle of Pendraic. By tradition, Penton expected to inherit the imperial diadem, yet the Senate cited the absence of any written law of succession to elect General Arenicos instead. Although Arenicos spared his life for the sake of Imperial stability, the humiliation of being stripped of his birthright has haunted him ever since. In the ensuing Imperial civil war, Penton stood firmly beside Lucon, leader of the Northern Empire—not only because of the Neretzes clan's long-standing oligarchic stance as northern frontier lords, but also to defend the authority of the Senate and prevent imperial power from falling once more into the hands of a tyrant. Today, holding court at Saneopa and ruling his family's vast fiefs, he repels northern barbarian raids while standing ever ready to restore the former glory of his house in a chaotic age.
